action.content: Write a funny poem for kids about a product that you would like to sell. The poem should have exactly 6 stanzas. Separated the stanzas using 3 asterisk markers: ***
action.label: context

action.content:
I'd like to sell a toy that's very new,
With a face that's made of plastic green.
It has a mouth that says "Hello!"
And a tail that wags when you're in need.
It's the best toy ever made,
With a sound that makes you laugh!
***

It's a robot that can talk to you,
And tell you what to do.
It knows your name and what you like,
And can even guess what you will do.
It's the smartest toy you'll ever buy,
With a brain that's as big as a house!
***

The robot can draw pictures too,
With a pencil that's made of wood.
It can even write your name,
And make it look just like you.
It's the best toy ever made,
With a hand that's as strong as a bear!
***

It can play games with you, too,
And win every single game you play.
It's the best toy ever made,
With a mind that's as fast as a ray!
It's the smartest toy you'll ever buy,
With a brain that's as big as a house!
***

The robot can even dance for you,
With a body that's made of metal.
It can do all the moves you want,
And make you feel like you're in a band!
It's the best toy ever made,
With a body that's as strong as a bear!
***

So if you want a toy that's new,
And can talk, draw, and dance for you,
Then I'd like to sell you this robot,
With a brain that's as big as a house!
It's the smartest toy you'll ever buy,
With a mind that's as fast as a ray!
action.label: response
